Report format (Markdown):
1) One-line title — the game in a phrase (e.g. «The night the doctor's protection saved the village»)
2) Three-line summary — who won, the moment the game tipped, the scene of the day
3) Flow of the game — short, in night/day order. Add the survivor count «Good n : Evil n» at each step, and an arrow (↗↘) for which way the game leaned
4) Three decisive moments — the moment · why it mattered · what if it had gone differently
5) Player cards — one line per player «seat name · role · side» + what they did this game + one thing they did well (one for everyone)
6) Evil's point of view — who they likely targeted and why, how they survived the days
7) The game in numbers — one table: execution accuracy (Evil among executions), Good's nomination accuracy, true info received, night attacks succeeded/blocked, game length (nights·days), most-nominated player, most accurate voter, and anything else the data can count
8) 2–3 tips for next game — something even beginners can use right away
9) Bonus — retell this game in 4–6 lines like a ghost story or radio tale (keep the role names)
Facts only: base everything only on «Game order» and «Raw data (JSON)» below. Don't invent conversations, expressions or intentions that aren't in the record; mark guesses with «maybe». Count numbers directly from the data.

자료 읽는 법: ① 원본 데이터의 «밤» 번호는 1 = 새벽, 2 = 밤: How to read the data: ① In the raw data, the «밤» (night) number 1 = Dawn, 2 = Night 1…, and the «낮» (day) number n = Day n. In writing, use «Dawn / Day n / Night n». ② By the rules, dead players can still vote (ghost vote, usually once per game). In a vote, the «유령표» (ghost vote) field marks someone who was already dead when casting it — don't treat it as a record error. ③ «True info received» is the share of info the app recorded that matched the facts (false if poisoned or drunk); it is not how well people deduced. ④ There is no conversation record. Don't write who persuaded whom or which words were decisive; pick titles, good plays and MVP only from recorded actions (nominations·votes·abilities·survival) and state that basis in one line.
